text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp kicks off. The Japan 
Dirt Derby is scheduled to take place 
during this camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the training camp grounds, Wonder Acute 
was surrounded by her juniors.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san. Good luck in the race! We're 
all right behind you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume on the left is "Hokko 
Tarumae." She's a local idol Umamusume who 
runs to put her hometown of Tomakomai, 
Hokkaido on the map.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the Umamusume on the right is 'Copano 
Rickey.' She's from the generation after 
Hokko Tarumae and runs powered by feng 
shui."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Tarumae-chan, 
Rickey-chan. Having you two around makes 
me feel so reassured.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Would you mind accompanying me for 
training leading up to the 'Japan Dirt 
Derby'?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I'd love to join you, but I won't be 
much of a match. I haven't even made my 
debut yet, after all...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If Tarumae can't do it, there's no way I 
can~. I'm totally not prepared at all!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, so running alongside me won't work 
out? Running alone feels so lonely, 
though~

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I can't run tandem with you, but there 
are things I can do as a local idol."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to sing! For your sake, 
Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll read your feng shui! Once we 
know your lucky direction, winning is 
totally in the bag!☆"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Tarumae-chan, 
Rickey-chan. Well then, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"In return, maybe I'll bake some cookies 
for the two of you. Then we're even..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine, Acute-san! You're the 
one being cheered on, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A heartwarming exchange. Spurred on by the 
cheers of her juniors, Wonder Acute is 
sure to try even harder.
